doc.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024

title: Introduction and Griffin's sleep habits
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Griffin as trombonist, composer and visual artist; Griffin says he is an early riser who sleeps about three hours.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Dick Griffin with me this morning, not exactly jazz musicians’ hours, but I’m going to introduce you as a trombonist, a composer, and a visual artist, and a very creative person from what I’ve listened to and seen and read. So thanks for joining me.

Thank you for inviting me, and it’s always a pleasure, and believe it or not I’m an early riser. I get up sometimes at 5, 6 and 7 o’clock in the morning. And also I do late nights. So I can stay up ‘til 3 and 4 and 5, whatever, at night, for playing in the nightclubs. So I don’t sleep a lot. I sleep three hours and that’s about it. But I can do it two or three times a day.
